note: Loki Research's published nozzle exit diameters are now in the app - 54 of their 58 in-production motors, read from their own Tech Info tables and reload-kit instruction sheets. Two earlier notes said Loki publish none; they do, at the foot of a page I had read, and both are corrected. The nozzle exit diameter now FOLLOWS THE MOTOR: change the motor and it changes, take the motor out and the field empties, and a line says what the removed value belonged to. A value that arrived with a file is still not overwritten. A cluster is now filled as one equivalent nozzle with the exit areas summed - the automatic fill added in v0.122 wrote one motor's diameter whatever the cluster count.
